item.description: This is National Consumer Protection Week and Kansas Attorney General, Chris Kobach, is joining consumer advocates nationwide to educate and empower citizens to recognize, report, and avoid scams and deceptive business practices. item.title: KS TAX REVENUE DOWN
item.description: Kansas ended February with total tax collections at $506.3 million. Governor Laura Kelly says that’s 10.3%, below the estimate. Total tax collections were down 7.6% from February of 2025. Kelly added that the individual tax collections were $205.7 million. The governor says that is 17.7% below the estimate. item.title: Gloria M. Terrill
item.description: Gloria M. Terrill, passed away on February 28, 2026, at Rock Creek of Ottawa in Ottawa, Kansas.
